item.title: Who benefits when massive AI data centers come to town?
item.description: The battle over data centers is hitting the ballot box. Brookings scholar Darrell West talks about how the backlash against the AI boom, flock cameras and tech companies is crossing party lines.

item.title: Greetings from Baghdad, where Agatha Christie's old home presents its own mystery
item.description: The English writer visited Iraq multiple times in the first half of the 20th century and set some of her mystery novels there. The house in Baghdad where she once lived now sits abandoned and crumbling.
item.content:encoded: The English writer visited Iraq multiple times in the first half of the 20th century and set some of her mystery novels there. The house in Baghdad where she once lived now sits abandoned and crumbling.

item.title: A stress-free guide to organizing important paperwork and documents
item.description: Got piles of mail stacking up in the kitchen? Not sure where your Social Security card is? It might be time to sort through your paperwork. Don't let it overwhelm you with this simple guide.

item.title: With days to go before the midterms, data shows the U.S. economy is doing well
item.description: GDP grew at an annual rate of 3.4% in the third quarter in the last major read on the economy ahead of the midterm elections — but many Americans continue to struggle with affordability.

item.title: GDP report to give insight before Election Day. And, Israel's election is deadlocked
item.description: Economists expect the GDP report to show economic growth, but say that growth is "fragile." And, after 90% of the votes in Israel have been counted, no clear winner has emerged.

item.title: How AI drones are influencing the course of the Ukraine war
item.description: Artificial intelligence is making drones faster and more capable. Russia and Ukraine both use AI-powered drones, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that AI could lead decisions on the battlefield as soon as next year.

item.title: These are the House races to watch in the 2026 midterm election on Nov. 3
item.description: An NPR analysis finds 70 House districts where Democrats and Republicans are each investing more than six figures in advertising during the final few days of the election, including in deep red areas.
